You're here! This is urgent, so I'll get straight to the point.
First, let me explain what kind of place this is...
It's known by many names: the shadow, the world beyond the mirror, the inner world, and so on.
I had no idea it existed.
strings.그럴 수밖에요. 존재를 아는 이들은 극히 소수고, 출입을 철저하게 통제하: That's understandable. Very few people know about it, and access is strictly controlled.
If either side loses its balance, both worlds will suffer greatly.
On the Jiendia continent, a special agency reporting directly to the Empress handles it...
Here at the Temple of Seres, we oversee Freios and several other regions.
The temple is short-handed at the moment, so we've had to ask for your help.
strings.그렇군요. 그러면 구체적으로 무슨 일이 발생한 거죠?: I see. So what exactly happened?
Something has distorted space and time, and demonic energy is pouring through the distortion.
The demon realm is filled with a deeply sinister energy.
It can even alter the very nature of certain living beings.
If this place becomes completely corrupted by it, the original World Tree will be in grave danger too.
strings.한쪽의 균형이 무너지면 양측 다 위험해진다고 했었던 것 때문에요?: Because both sides are in danger if either one loses its balance, like you said?
Exactly. In the end, they're the same place.
I'll look for the cause. Please defeat the creatures that have been corrupted by the demonic energy.
If we don't purify this place quickly, something terrible will happen.
A dark wizard's apprentices tried to summon a demon and failed. That's what caused this.
strings.왜죠? 그리고 하필 이곳에서 그런 짓을…?: Why? And why would they do something like that here, of all places...?
Dark wizards are enemies of us all.
They bargain with dangerous beings from the demon realm, or from other worlds...
Offering their souls as collateral for power, then using it to commit vile deeds.
The temple and many other organizations keep a very close watch on them.
They seem to have tried summoning a demon to gain even greater power, but...
I think they chose a very unfortunate time.
Demigod Belosh moved the World Tree to a new location, remember?
That left the wizards who had sneaked inside with no way to return...
And their summoning ritual failed as well...
Anyway, now that we know the cause, we can deal with it.
strings.도와주실 수 있으신가요?: Would you be willing to help?
If it's something I can do, I'll help.
Then please use your skills to drive out the evil energy inside.
Of course. I'll have that taken care of in no time.
I'll leave the finishing touches to you. Hehe.
Oh, all I did was a little purification. I hardly had to exert myself.
Ah, there's one more thing I'd like to ask...
Please keep the reverse world a secret.
Access to this world is strictly controlled...
And if too many people learn about it, the world will eventually fall into confusion.
There are various other dangers as well...
strings.도움이 필요하면 언제든지 연락해 주세요!: If you need help, contact me anytime!
